svg.title: Diabetes is more closely associated with physical inactivity
svg.desc: County-level 2023 age-adjusted estimates; n=2,956. Lines are descriptive least-squares trends, not causal effects.
svg.text: Diabetes is more closely associated with physical inactivity
County-level 2023 age-adjusted estimates; n=2,956. Lines are descriptive least-squares trends, not causal effects.
No leisure-time physical activity vs diagnosed diabetes
Each dot is one county or county-equivalent; Kentucky and Pennsylvania are absent because these 2023 estimates are unpublished.
